question_text: The Philippines, as a member of the United Nations, is considering joining a military alliance that would require it to participate in offensive wars. Under Article II of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following statements is correct?

The Philippines may join only if the war is defensive in nature.
The Philippines cannot join because the Constitution renounces war as an instrument of national policy.
The Philippines may join if Congress declares war.
